source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check BMC manager information and details.
source_snapshot.criteria: System data is readable/correct and all firmware versions are correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes `/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc`, disables TLS verification, exposes credentials, returns only FirmwareVersion and Status, omits actual WebUI evidence and cannot prove every firmware component/version required by the Criteria.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE correctly adds Manager collection/member discovery, complete identity/firmware/status/time/link fields, protected access, redaction and optional WebUI correlation, but its top-level wording needs an explicit manager-associated component/version matrix to satisfy `all FW version correct`.

old_problem: The read-only target is identifiable, yet the case remained Pending because exact Manager member, WebUI fields and the scope of `all FW version correct` were not bound. DeepSeek's conventional URI and two properties could yield credible but incomplete evidence and silently treat missing active/backup/additional firmware records as pass.
disposition_reason: Use protected read-only service-root/Managers discovery, bind the intended BMC Manager to the selected system/chassis, capture the actual WebUI manager/detail presentation, and enumerate the Project-required firmware components through top-level FirmwareVersion, AdditionalFirmwareVersions, ActiveSoftwareImage and applicable FirmwareInventory records. Exact expected versions are Project configuration. No manager reset, update or configuration write is required.
decision_basis: XLSX row 947, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record, physical row 948 and next pending row 949 were directly reviewed; next pending identity was verified as Functionality row 949 / variant bfa858a238c7a2e1.
Items, Procedure and both Criteria consistently target BMC Manager information and firmware correctness. `System data` is generic wording in this row context, not a competing ComputerSystem target.

DMTF Manager schema permits multiple Manager members, identifies the manager-to-system/chassis relationships, supplies FirmwareVersion and AdditionalFirmwareVersions, and can link ActiveSoftwareImage to SoftwareInventory. A fixed `/Managers/bmc` URI is not authoritative.

DMTF SoftwareInventory represents component firmware/software and its Version/Status/Updateable metadata; a Project component allow-list and expected matrix make `all` finite and auditable without inventing versions.
ED-03/ED-13 and ED-33 through ED-38 allow a schema-driven read-only contract with Project version bindings while preserving actual WebUI coverage, strict no-write scope and engineer-owned verdict.

test_case.test_name: Validate the selected BMC Manager detail and every required associated firmware version in WebUI and Redfish
test_case.purpose: Verify that the intended BMC Manager is correctly identified, its complete readable identity/status/detail fields match the actual WebUI, and every Project-required manager-associated active/additional firmware component matches the approved version matrix, with explicit treatment of backup/staged/unknown/missing records and no management mutation.
required_package: Immutable BMC/SUT/ComputerSystem/chassis identity, firmware/WebUI build, trusted TLS chain, protected read-only credentials and sensitive manager/network field redaction
Service-root-discovered Managers collection, intended Manager selection rule using ManagerForServers/ManagerForChassis or vendor mapping, and supported Manager/SoftwareInventory schemas

Approved Manager detail field matrix: Id, Name, Description, ManagerType, Model, UUID/redacted identity, FirmwareVersion, AdditionalFirmwareVersions, Status, PowerState if applicable, DateTime/offset semantics and required links

Finite Project firmware component/version matrix with component identity, active/backup/staged role, normalization rule, required/optional status, expected version and allowed null/unsupported behavior
Links.ActiveSoftwareImage and applicable UpdateService/FirmwareInventory association rules plus pagination/member-detail handling
Actual WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs BMC manager table/detail field mapping, screenshot/redaction rules and UI/API freshness tolerance
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify immutable target and discover the Managers collection from the Redfish service root; do not assume member ID `bmc`. Enumerate all Manager members and select the intended BMC only by approved identity and ManagerForServers/ManagerForChassis relationships. Capture its complete redacted resource and normalize required identity/type/model/FirmwareVersion/AdditionalFirmwareVersions/Status/PowerState/time/link fields. Follow Links.ActiveSoftwareImage and the service-root UpdateService FirmwareInventory collection, pagination and every Project-required member; record Id/name/version/version-scheme/status/updateable plus active/backup/staged association without invoking any action. Open the actual WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs BMC manager table and each required detail/firmware view, capture timestamped visual evidence and compare every mapped value. Compare the normalized finite component set to the approved Project matrix; keep missing, duplicate, stale, unknown/null, unsupported, mismatched and extra records distinct. Repeat only read-only fingerprints to prove no change. Do not use `curl -k`, process-visible credentials, Manager.Reset, SoftwareInventory.Activate, update, network, account, power or configuration writes, or log clearing.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one intended BMC Manager is bound to the selected system/chassis; every required manager identity/status/detail field is readable, schema-valid, current and equal between Redfish, actual WebUI and the Project baseline. Every required firmware component appears exactly once in the correct active/backup/staged role and its normalized version equals the approved expected value; top-level FirmwareVersion and AdditionalFirmwareVersions reconcile with linked inventory where applicable. Missing/unknown/unsupported/extra components are reported by policy rather than silently passing, sensitive fields are redacted traceably and pre/post/audit evidence proves no state change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative Manager discovery/binding, complete required fields, actual WebUI visual parity and an exact per-component comparison for the entire approved firmware matrix. A successful GET, one conventional member, top-level FirmwareVersion alone, Status alone or partial FirmwareInventory cannot pass `all FW version correct`. Wrong/ambiguous Manager, missing/duplicate/stale component, version/role mismatch, unexplained null/unsupported field, UI/API mismatch, absent expected matrix or any write attempt is FAIL or NOT READY as defined by Project policy; missing Project versions is NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Use only certificate-verified protected GET/read operations discovered from the service root; do not use `curl -k`, expose credentials or assume `/Managers/bmc`.
Keep this case strictly read-only. Never invoke Manager.Reset/ResetToDefaults, UpdateService, SoftwareInventory.Activate, network, account, power or configuration actions and never clear logs.
Bind the Manager to the selected system/chassis before interpreting versions; stop on multiple ambiguous members, broken relationship links or wrong asset identity.
Do not interpret one FirmwareVersion as all firmware. Traverse every Project-required active/additional/inventory component and preserve component role and association.
Distinguish missing, duplicate, extra, unknown/null, unsupported, stale and request/auth/transport failure; none is automatically a correct version.
Redact UUID/network/serial/asset data according to policy while retaining stable tokens, timestamps and raw-to-normalized hashes for audit.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/SUT/WebUI identity, trusted session, discovered Managers collection, selected-member rationale, schema versions and system/chassis relationship proof
Complete raw redacted Manager response and normalized identity/type/model/status/time/link/FirmwareVersion/AdditionalFirmwareVersions matrix
Complete applicable active/additional/FirmwareInventory collection/member evidence with component identity, role, Version/VersionScheme/Status and Project expected comparison
Actual WebUI BMC manager/detail/firmware visual artifacts with field-by-field API/UI reconciliation and freshness timestamps
Pre/post read-only fingerprints, preserved audit/log evidence, explicit missing/extra/unsupported outcomes and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On wrong Manager, incomplete pagination/association, schema mismatch, credential exposure or UI/API disagreement, stop the read-only collection, preserve/redact evidence and close the session. Do not reset, update or reconfigure the BMC to make values match; obtain the correct mapping or Project matrix.
